title: The Weight of Light
synopsis: A solitary stage caretaker discovers a luminous sprout pinned behind a heavy block. It braces, pushes, nearly gives up, then clears the obstruction and bows in relief.

shots.purpose: Establish isolation and discovery of the trapped sprout
shots.performance: Quiet gaze, delayed head turn, weight shift and tentative arm lift
shots.continuity: Block starts at x=1.36; bloom obscured and unclaimed

shots.purpose: Let the audience feel the effort of freeing the sprout
shots.performance: Upper body leans, both arms counterbalance, right hand contacts and moves the block
shots.continuity: The block moves under continued visible hand contact, with both feet planted until frame 272

shots.purpose: Reveal the living sprout and let relief resolve into a small bow
shots.performance: Push ends, head tracks revealed bloom, torso rises, jaw opens and figure bows
shots.continuity: Block slides out until frame 272, hand disengages afterwards, then the sprout is revealed and the actor bows
